system.description:
You can twist your features into a startling mask.

Prerequisite: Shapeshift Species Trait

Effect: Once per encounter, as a Swift Action, you can make a Deception check against one opponent that can see you. If the check equals or exceeds the opponent's Will Defense, you move the target 1 square away from you and it takes a -1 penalty on all attacks until the start of your next turn. This is a Mind-Affecting Fear effect.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
